G1.name: Strategy and scope
G1.where: The point of the first diamond, where research becomes a plan
G1.question: Is this the right site to build, for the right people, on the right stack?
packet: One screen of strategy: who it's for and what it must prove
The sitemap and the story, chapter by chapter
The stack, with what it costs and what you'll maintain
Every open question, each with lettered options and a recommendation
Review's verdict on all of it

options.label: Accept all recommendations
options.detail: The team proceeds exactly as proposed.

options.label: Pick per question
options.detail: Answer by number and letter, for example "Q2 C, Q5 B".

options.label: Revise
options.detail: Say what's wrong; the team reworks the packet inside the same gate.

decision.quote: Mostly yes. Host it on Vercel, make the quotes up, and push the creativity as far as it'll go.
decision.consequence: The stack moved to Vercel, the story stopped quoting the repo and started telling it, and 'creative' became the measure of success.

revise.quote: Revise: the hosting question doesn't say what we lose if the repo stays private.
revise.outcome: Backend added the trade-off to the packet, Review re-checked it, and the question came back the same afternoon.

G2.name: Creative direction
G2.where: Inside the second diamond, after Concept's three directions
G2.question: Which direction should the site take?
packet: Three directions side by side: moodboard, palette, type pairing, key art, style tile
What each direction is betting on, in one sentence
Every image's provenance label and licence
Review's verdict, including a visual check of the generated art

options.label: Combine
options.detail: For example, B's palette with C's type. Concept merges them into one direction.

decision.quote: B, but with C's type. And keep that weird hand-drawn arrow.
decision.consequence: Concept merged the two into one direction and wrote it down as the design system everything after this follows.

revise.quote: Revise: all three feel like the same studio in different jackets.
revise.outcome: Concept threw out the safest direction and made a stranger one. The second round is the one you're looking at.

G3.name: Design selection
G3.where: Late in the second diamond, after three coded variations
G3.question: Which coded variation becomes the real site?
packet: Three working home pages, each built on its own git branch
Screenshots of each at 390, 768, 1440 and 1920 pixels wide
Each variation's hypothesis: what it's trying to prove
Impeccable's critique, the slop detector's result, and Review's verdict

options.label: Variation A
options.detail: Build the full site on it.

options.label: Variation B
options.detail: Build the full site on it.

options.label: Variation C
options.detail: Build the full site on it.

options.label: Combine
options.detail: Name the parts: "A's hero, C's chapter rail".

decision.quote: A. It's the only one I scrolled to the end of without meaning to.
decision.consequence: Variation A merged into the main branch. The other two stay on their branches until launch, in case anything's worth stealing.

revise.quote: Revise: the mobile hero buries the setup sentence.
revise.outcome: Front-end moved the sentence above the fold at 390 pixels and re-shot all four widths.

G4.name: Release sign-off
G4.where: The end of the second diamond, before anything goes public
G4.question: Is it ready to go live?
packet: The finished site, on a private preview link
Review's audit: accessibility, Lighthouse on mobile, contrast, slop detector
A proofread of every page, and a licence check of every image
The deploy plan, and what you'll need to look after

options.label: Ship it
options.detail: The preview becomes the public site.

options.label: Ship with follow-ups
options.detail: Go live; the listed fixes follow.

options.label: Revise
options.detail: Nothing goes public until the listed issues are fixed.

decision.consequence: The preview became the public site. That's the page you're reading.

revise.quote: Revise: two buttons fail contrast in dark mode, and the credits page is missing a licence.
revise.outcome: Front-end fixed the colours, Backend added the licence, and Review signed off on the second pass.
